"Website bana li, ab customer apne aap aayenge" — sach ya myth? 🤔

Myth hai. Website aapke business ka pata hai. Customer tak pahunchne ke liye use jodna padta hai:
1️⃣ Google par dikhein — sahi title, description aur services pages
2️⃣ Google Business Profile banayein — Maps aur "near me" search ke liye
3️⃣ WhatsApp / Call button rakhein — customer ek tap mein aap tak pahunche

Website hai par customer nahi aa rahe? WhatsApp karein 📲 79742 17411

Save karein, aur jo dost business chalata hai usko bhejiye.
